description: This file defines the DeviceAnnouncedEvent class, a subclass of Event, representing a device announcement event in a Zigbee core simulation. It includes properties such as EUI-64 address, device type (router or end device), and power source (mains or battery), along with corresponding getter methods.

classes.name: DeviceAnnouncedEvent
classes.description: Represents a device announcement event with properties for EUI-64 address, device type (router or end device), and power source (mains or battery). Provides methods to access these properties.

methods.name: DeviceAnnouncedEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with EUI-64 address, device type, and power source.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI-64 addressing string of the device.

methods.name: getDeviceType
methods.description: Returns 'router' if the device is a router, otherwise 'endDevice'.

methods.name: getPowerSource
methods.description: Returns 'mains' if powered by mains, otherwise 'battery'.
